ModMetaData.name: Everybody Gets One Forked
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe, Uuugggg, Memegoddess
ModMetaData.description:
Set a bill to craft things until there's one for each person in the colony.
Adds three bill repeat modes: - Do one per person (+ X): keep one for every person, plus X spare. - Do X per person: keep X for every person. - Do while more than X: craft while you have more than X of the ingredient.
Choose who counts as a person for each bill, or set a default for the colony: colonists, slaves, prisoners, quest lodgers, colony mechanoids and colony animals, on the bill's map or on every map.
A fork of Everybody Gets One - Continued that needs only Harmony: no TD Find Library. Don't use it alongside the original.
